build_xml_with_etree: build an XML document from a pandas DataFrame using the EtreeXMLFormatter class
build_xml_with_lxml: build an XML document from a pandas DataFrame using the LxmlXMLFormatter class
transform_xml_with_xslt: transform an XML document generated by LxmlXMLFormatter using an XSLT stylesheet
format_dataframe_as_xml: format a pandas DataFrame as XML with custom namespaces, prefixes, and column attributes
write_xml_to_file: write a pandas DataFrame to an XML file with compression and custom encoding
